environment.description: ASP.NET Core 7.0 API deployed on Azure App Service (Basic tier B1). Service-to-service authentication uses long-lived API keys distributed via environment variables to calling microservices. Keys are shared across 4 upstream services via Azure Key Vault with manual rotation policy. No request body validation middleware. Default Kestrel configuration with no request size limits modified.

config.auth: static API key in env var, manual rotation quarterly
